alert.recommendation: Validate that the system alert is visible in the Unity user interface for the affected appliance. If it is and the alert persists in Aria Operations, investigate the Unity system and contact support if needed.
Validate that the pool alert is visible in the Unity user interface for the affected storage pool. If it is and the alert persists in Aria Operations, review pool capacity and health in Unity.

Validate that the storage resource alert is visible in the Unity user interface for the affected LUN, virtual disk, or block resource. If it is and the alert persists in Aria Operations, investigate the backing resource in Unity.

Validate that the file system alert is visible in the Unity user interface for the affected file resource. If it is and the alert persists in Aria Operations, review file system capacity and health in Unity.

Validate that the NAS server alert is visible in the Unity user interface for the affected NAS server. If it is and the alert persists in Aria Operations, review NAS services and backing storage in Unity.

Validate that the file interface alert is visible in the Unity user interface for the affected file interface. If it is and the alert persists in Aria Operations, review IP configuration, port bindings, and NAS service state in Unity.

Validate that the host alert is visible in the Unity user interface for the affected host. If it is and the alert persists in Aria Operations, review host registration, initiator access, and mapped storage in Unity.

Validate that the storage processor alert is visible in the Unity user interface for the affected SP. If it is and the alert persists in Aria Operations, investigate processor health, reboot state, and service status in Unity.

Validate that the enclosure alert is visible in the Unity user interface for the affected DPE or DAE. If it is and the alert persists in Aria Operations, investigate enclosure power, temperature, and disk health in Unity.

Validate that the physical disk alert is visible in the Unity user interface for the affected disk. If it is and the alert persists in Aria Operations, investigate the disk state, enclosure, and spare coverage in Unity.

Validate that the Ethernet port alert is visible in the Unity user interface for the affected port. If it is and the alert persists in Aria Operations, review link state, port speed, and related file or IP services in Unity.

Validate that the FC port alert is visible in the Unity user interface for the affected port. If it is and the alert persists in Aria Operations, review SAN connectivity, speed, and port health in Unity.

Validate that the replication alert is visible in the Unity user interface for the affected replication session. If it is and the alert persists in Aria Operations, review sync status, transfer progress, and source or destination health in Unity.

dashboards.description: At-a-glance Unity health, filesystem risk, and alert visibility.

config.editorData:
EMC Unity Executive Overview
A storage-centric landing page that balances health, capacity risk, and alert visibility. Forecast widgets use native Aria Operations capacity analytics where available.
Capacity
Focus first on pools and filesystems with shrinking headroom.
Forecast
Time remaining values surface projected exhaustion, not raw free space.
Alerts
Use severity and risk together to separate noise from urgent action.

config.title: Capacity and Forecasting
config.editorData:
EMC Unity Capacity and Forecasting
This view is tuned for drilldown. Select a pool, storage resource, or filesystem to compare raw capacity against Aria risk and time-remaining analytics.
Pools
Compare used, free, and projected exhaustion side by side.
Volumes
Storage resources and filesystems share a common forecast path here.
Forecast
Blank time-remaining values usually indicate capacity analytics still warming up.

dashboards.description: Drill into pool, storage resource, and filesystem capacity plus projected time remaining.

config.title: File Services and Replication
config.editorData:
EMC Unity File Services and Replication
Use this view to move from filesystems to NAS servers, interfaces, and replication sessions without losing operational context.
NAS
Trace shared storage back to its data services layer.
Replication
Keep replication drift and risk visible beside service topology.
Context
Relationship maps help explain why a healthy filesystem can still be service-impacting.

dashboards.description: File service health, replication context, and service topology in one place.

config.title: Hardware and Alerts
config.editorData:
EMC Unity Hardware and Alerts
A combined hardware and alert surface for fast triage. Start with health badges, then pivot into the alert stream to confirm urgency.
Hardware
Inspect processors, enclosures, disks, and ports without leaving the dashboard.
Ports
Speed and topology stay visible so fabric issues are easier to spot.
Alerts
Severity is surfaced alongside the live alert name to help cut through noise.
